title: Law to ban the fastest class of e-bikes
summary: This bill would prohibit operating class 3 e-bicycles, which can reach 25 mph on motor power alone, on city streets, in parks and in other public places. Violations before April 1, 2029 would only get a warning, while later violations would carry civil penalties of up to $50 for a second offense and $100 for later offenses, with possible impoundment for unsafe repeat violations. The law would take effect 24 months after enactment.
